statements.status_notes: Upstream GCC commit 5d419c69ce2e6b86d7da75f18736904885674219 changes libstdc++ bitset stream extraction so wide-character input no longer writes past a stack buffer sized in characters rather than bytes. The DHI build of the Debian gcc-13 source applies this upstream fix as a patch, so the packaged libstdc++ includes it. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-115455
